This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of the BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Bargarh Town PS Case No.496 of 2023 arising out of CT Case No.41 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned ADJ-cum- Special Court under POCSO Act, Bargarh, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 363/ 366/ 376(2)(n)/ 306/ 304(B)/ 34 of IPC r/w Sec.6 of POCSO Act & Sec.9 of Child Marriage Act, on the main allegation of committing dowry death and abetment of suicide of his daughter-in- law by intentionally assisting the co-accused to kidnap the victim and ravishing as well as committing penetrative sexual on her and getting the victim child married to that co-accused.
3. Heard, Mr. Satya Ranjan Mulia, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. M.R. Patra, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.

4. It is not in dispute that co-accused Rahul Singh, who had allegedly married to the victim has already been granted bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court in BLAPL No.9050 of 2024, but the present petitioner being a old lady is languishing in jail custody since 20.02.2025 and in the meantime charge-sheet has already been submitted.

In such view of the matter and after having considered the rival submissions and taking into account the other circumstances on record in entirety and looking at the status and age of the petitioner and applying the first proviso appended to Sec.480 of BNS, this Court without expressing any view on merit admits the petitioner to bail.
